limits.overrides: Schema-validated overrides can only lower the request/body/capture limits. Byte reservations conservatively count tagged upload attempts, including overwrites and failures.

actualControls: Sequential request exhaustion refuses later storage access and invalidates the receipt.
A request larger than the admitted app body limit cannot become an empty upload.
Aggregate replay body/tag bytes are reserved before forwarding.
An actual interrupted upload creates no upstream write and invalidates evidence.
An oversized streamed upstream reply is rejected and cannot yield complete evidence.
Concurrent requests reserve the request count atomically.
Concurrent distinct uploads reserve at most64 replay entries before upstream writes.
